name: Kosmos-573
about: Kosmos-573 (1973-041A), a crewed vehicle (7K-T), launched 1973 Jun 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1973 Jun 16), held fixed
